muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿فجعلهم جذاذا إلا كبيرا لهم لعلهم إليه يرجعون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction conjoining to something omitted, its implied form being: "so they turned away, and Abraham came to the idols, and made them…" ﴿فولوا فأتى إبراهيم الأصنام فجعلهم ...﴾; جعلهم: verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جذاذًا: second mafʿūl bihi; إلا: a particle of exception; كبيرًا: excepted (mustathnā) from the hāʾ; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كبيرا﴾; لعلهم: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); إليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرجعون﴾; the clause ﴿يرجعون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿قالوا من فعل هذا بآلهتنا﴾: قالوا: verb and fāʿil (agent); مَن: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿فعل﴾ is the khabar (predicate); هذا: the object of فعل; ﴿بآلهتنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فعل﴾.
﴿إنه لمن الظالمين﴾: إنه: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); من الظالمين: the khabar of إن; the clause ﴿إنه لمن الظالمين﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿قالوا سمعنا فتى يذكرهم يقال له إبراهيم﴾: سمعنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿سمعنا﴾ is the speech (maqūl) of the saying; فتى: the object of سمعنا; the clause ﴿يذكرهم﴾ is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿فتى﴾, and it has also been parsed as being in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿سمعنا﴾; the clause ﴿يقال﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿فتى﴾; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقال﴾; إبراهيم: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the verb ﴿يقال﴾, or one addressed (munādā) with the vocative particle omitted, the implied form being: "it is said to him: O Abraham".

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿قالوا فأتوا به على أعين الناس لعلهم يشهدون﴾: قالوا: verb and fāʿil (agent); فأتوا: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ, implying an omitted condition), and أتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) His saying: ﴿فأتوا﴾; ﴿على أعين الناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in ﴿به﴾; لعلهم: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يشهدون﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿قالوا أأنت فعلت هذا بآلهتنا يا إبراهيم﴾: أأنت: the hamza is for interrogation, and أنت is mubtadaʾ (subject); فعلت: verb and fāʿil (agent); هذا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿فعلت﴾ is the khabar (predicate); بآلهتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فعلت﴾; يا: a vocative particle; إبراهيم: one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; the clause ﴿أأنت فعلت ...﴾ is the speech (maqūl) of the saying, in the position of accusative.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿قال بل فعله كبيرهم هذا﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿فعله﴾: past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كبيرهم: the postponed fāʿil (agent); هذا: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كبيرهم﴾ or a badal (substitute) from it.
﴿فاسألوهم إن كانوا ينطقون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ); اسألوهم: imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; إن is conditional; كانوا: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the wāw is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿ينطقون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "then ask them".

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿فرجعوا إلى أنفسهم فقالوا إنكم أنتم الظالمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; رجعوا: past verb and fāʿil (agent); إلى أنفسهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رجعوا﴾. فقالوا: conjoined to فرجعوا; إنكم: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿أنتم الظالمون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; or ﴿أنتم﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and ﴿الظالمون﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿ثم نكسوا على رءوسهم﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay (tarākhī); نكسوا: a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); على رءوسهم: preposition, genitive noun and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in نكسوا, i.e.: "being upon their heads", or attached to the verb نكسوا.
﴿لقد علمت ما هؤلاء ينطقون﴾: ﴿لقد﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿علمت﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā that operates like laysa; ﴿هؤلاء﴾: the noun (ism) of mā; the clause ﴿ينطقون﴾ is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾. Or ﴿ما﴾ is negating and non-operative, ﴿هؤلاء﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿ينطقون﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿ما هؤلاء ينطقون﴾ is in the place of accusative, filling the place of the two objects of ﴿علمت﴾, or in the place of a single object if علمت means "you knew/recognised" (ʿarafta); the clause ﴿لقد علمت ...﴾ is in the position of accusative as the speech (maqūl) of an implied verb of saying, and the implied saying is in the place of a ḥāl from the agent of ﴿نكسوا﴾, the implied form being: "then they were turned upon their heads, saying: By Allah, you have certainly…".

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿قال أفتعبدون من دون الله ما لا ينفعكم شيئا ولا يضركم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is a conjunction conjoining to something omitted; تعبدون: imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من دون الله﴾: preposition, genitive noun and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لا ينفعكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿شيئًا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a description of the maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿لا يضركم﴾ is conjoined to لا ينفعكم.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿أف لكم ولما تعبدون من دون الله﴾: أف is a verbal noun (ism fiʿl) of the imperfect, meaning: "I feel weary/vexed"; ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أف﴾; لما تعبدون: conjoined to لكم; the clause ﴿تعبدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿من دون الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied object of تعبدون, i.e.: "and to what you worship, it being besides Allah".
﴿أفلا تعقلون﴾: أفلا: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is a conjunction conjoining to something omitted; لا is negating; تعقلون: imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿قالوا حرقوه وانصروا آلهتكم إن كنتم فاعلين﴾: قالوا: verb and fāʿil (agent); حرقوه: imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech (maqūl) of the saying, in the position of accusative; انصروا: imperative verb and fāʿil; آلهتكم: mafʿūl bihi; إن is conditional; كنتم: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ in ﴿كنتم﴾ is the noun (ism) of كان, and ﴿فاعلين﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the apodosis (jawāb) of إن is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "then burn him and support your gods".

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿قلنا يا نار كوني بردا وسلاما على إبراهيم﴾: قلنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); يا: a vocative particle; نار: one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; كوني: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperative verb, and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿بردًا﴾: its khabar (predicate); ﴿سلامًا﴾: conjoined to ﴿بردًا﴾; ﴿على إبراهيم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سلامًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿وأرادوا به كيدا فجعلناهم الأخسرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أرادوا: past verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرادوا﴾; ﴿كيدًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فجعلناهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿جعلناهم﴾ is past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿جعلناهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أراداوا﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the Quranic word is أرادوا]; الأخسرين: second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿ونجيناه ولوطا إلى الأرض التي باركنا فيها للعالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; نجيناه: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لوطًا﴾: conjoined to the hāʾ, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), the wāw being the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya); إلى الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نجيناه﴾ or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); التي: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿لأرض﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; الأرض is meant]; the clause ﴿باركنا فيها للعالمين﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position; فيها: ḥāl; وللعاملين [Translator's note: so written in the source; the Quranic word is للعالمين]: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿باركنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿ووهبنا له إسحاق ويعقوب نافلة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; وهبنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وهبنا﴾; إسحاق: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يعقوب: conjoined to إسحاق; نافلة: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from يعقوب.
﴿وكلا جعلنا صالحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كلًّا: the first object of جعلنا, fronted; جعلنا: verb and fāʿil; صالحين: second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وجعلناهم أئمة يهدون بأمرنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جعلناهم: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أئمة: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يهدون بأمرنا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of أئمة; ﴿بأمرنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "they guide to Our religion, being invested with Our command".
﴿وأوحينا إليهم فعل الخيرات وإقام الصلاة وإيتاء الزكاة وكانوا لنا عابدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أوحينا is conjoined to what precedes; إليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾; ﴿فعل الخيرات﴾: mafʿūl bihi and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿إقام الصلاة﴾: conjoined to فعل الخيرات; ﴿إيتاء الزكاة﴾: conjoined to فعل الخيرات. ﴿وكانوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كانوا: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun (ism); عابدين: its khabar (predicate); ﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عابدين.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿ولوطا آتيناه حكما وعلما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; لوطًا: accusative by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it, i.e.: "We gave Lot"; it is thus a case of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb with a pronoun). The clause ﴿آتيناه...﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya) with no grammatical position. حكمًا: the second object of ﴿آتيناه﴾. علمًا: conjoined to حكمًا.
﴿ونجيناه من القرية التي كانت تعمل الخبائث﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; نجيناه: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من القرية: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نجيناه﴾; التي: a naʿt (adjective) of القرية; the clause ﴿كانت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position; the noun (ism) of كانت is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هي; the clause ﴿تعمل الخبائث﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كانت.
﴿إنهم كانوا قوم سوء فاسقين﴾: the clause إنهم is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position; إنهم: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; كانوا: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; قوم: the khabar of كانوا; سوء: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); فاسقين: a naʿt of قوم; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿وأدخلناه في رحمتنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أدخلناه: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl (object); في رحمتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أدخلناه﴾.
﴿إنه من الصالحين﴾: إنه: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); من الصالحين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause ﴿إنه من الصالحين﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿ونوحا إذ نادى من قبل فاستجبنا له فنجيناه وأهله من الكرب العظيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; نوحا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being ﴿اذكر﴾ ("remember"), with an implied muḍāf, i.e.: "and remember the story of Noah"; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. إذ: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied muḍāf. The clause ﴿نادى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿من قبل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نادى﴾. فاستجبنا: conjoined to نادى; استجبنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استجبنا﴾; فنجيناه is conjoined to استجبنا; نجيناه: verb, fāʿil and object; ﴿أهله﴾: conjoined to the pronoun; ﴿من الكرب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجيناه﴾; العظيم: a naʿt (adjective) of الكرب.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿ونصرناه من القوم الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; نصرناه: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من القوم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نصرناه﴾; الذين: a naʿt (adjective) of القوم; the clause ﴿كذبوا بآياتنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنهم كانوا قوم سوء فأغرقناهم أجمعين﴾: إنهم: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); كانوا: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; قوم سوء: the khabar (predicate) of كانوا; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the khabar of إن, and the clause ﴿إنهم ...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. فأغرقناهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أغرقناهم: verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; أجمعين: tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in ﴿أغرقناهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿وداود وسليمان إذ يحكمان في الحرث إذ نفشت فيه غنم القوم وكنا لحكمهم شاهدين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; داود: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being ﴿اذكر﴾ ("remember"), with a muḍāf omitted, the implied form being: "and remember the story of David and Solomon when they were judging"; سليمان: conjoined to داود; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; إذ: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied muḍāf; the clause ﴿يحكمان﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); في الحرث: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحكمان﴾; إذ: an adverb attached to ﴿يحكمان﴾; the clause ﴿نفشت﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نفشت﴾; ﴿غنم القوم﴾: fāʿil (agent) and muḍāf ilayhi. كنا: the wāw is a conjunction; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿شاهدين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كان; لحكمهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شاهدين﴾.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿ففهمناها سليمان وكلا آتينا حكما وعلما﴾: ففهمناها is conjoined to يحكمان; فهمناها: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سليمان: second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿كلًا﴾: the first object of آتينا, fronted; ﴿حكمًا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi of آتينا; علمًا: conjoined to حكما.
﴿وسخرنا مع داود الجبال يسبحن والطير وكنا فاعلين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; سخرنا: verb and fāʿil; مع: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سخرنا﴾; داود: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الجبال: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يسبحن﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from الجبال, i.e.: "glorifying", or resumptive with no grammatical position; الطير: conjoined to الجبال, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). كنا: the wāw is a conjunction; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿فاعلين﴾: its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿وعلمناه صنعة لبوس لكم لتحصنكم من بأسكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; علمناه is conjoined to سخرنا; علمناه: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); صنعة: the second object of ﴿علمناه﴾; لبوس: muḍāf [Translator's note: so in the source; لبوس is in fact the muḍāf ilayhi of صنعة]; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of لبوس, the lām then being for ownership (tamlīk); or attached to ﴿علمناه﴾, the lām then being causal (taʿlīl), and on this view His saying ﴿لتحصنكم﴾ is a badal (substitute) with repetition of the lām; on the first view His saying ﴿لتحصنكم﴾ is attached to ﴿علمنا﴾. لتحصنكم: the lām is causal; تحصنكم: imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of cause; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿علمناه﴾; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هي; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من بأسكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحصنكم﴾.
﴿فهل أنتم شاكرون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أنتم: mubtadaʾ (subject); شاكرون: khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿ولسليمان الريح عاصفة تجري بأمره إلى الأرض التي باركنا فيها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لسليمان: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: "We subjected"; الريح: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb; عاصفة: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿تجري بأمره﴾ is a second ḥāl; إلى الأرض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; التي: a naʿt (adjective) of الأرض; the clause ﴿باركنا فيها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكنا بكل شيء عالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كنا: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); بكل شيء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عالمين; عالمين: the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿ومن الشياطين من يغوصون له ويعملون عملا دون ذلك﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; من الشياطين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مَن: relative (mawṣūla) or indefinite-described (mawṣūfa), the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). Or ﴿مَن﴾ is in the position of accusative, conjoined to ﴿الريح﴾, so that the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted verb سخرنا. The clause ﴿يغوصون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغوصون﴾; the clause ﴿ومن الشياطين...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined; يعملون: conjoined to يغوصون; عملا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) or mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); دون: an adverb attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عملا﴾; ذلك: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وكنا لهم حافظين﴾: كنا: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); حافظين: its khabar; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حافظين.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿وأيوب إذ نادى ربه أني مسني الضر وأنت أرحم الراحمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; أيوب: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "remember"; it involves the omission of a muḍāf, the implied form being: "and remember the story of Job when he called"; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; إذ: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted muḍāf; the clause ﴿نادى ربه﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ربه: the object of نادى; أني: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause مسني الضر is the khabar (predicate) of أن; أنّ and what lies within its scope are accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "with: that I…" (bi-annī). وأنت: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنت: mubtadaʾ (subject); أرحم: khabar; الراحمين: muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿فاستجبنا له فكشفنا ما به من ضر﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; استجبنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استجبنا﴾; فكشفنا: conjoined to فاستجبنا; ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; ﴿من ضر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وآتيناه أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة من عندنا وذكرى للعابدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتيناه: verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; أهله: second mafʿūl bihi; مثلهم: conjoined to أهله, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); معهم: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "being with them"; رحمة: a mafʿūl min ajlihi (object of purpose), or the maṣdar (verbal noun) of an implied verb, i.e.: "We had mercy on him with a mercy"; the first is preferable. من عندنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة; ذكرى: conjoined to رحمة; للعابدين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ذكرى.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿وإسماعيل وإدريس وذا الكفل﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إسماعيل: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "remember"; إدريس: conjoined to إسماعيل; ذا الكفل: also conjoined to إسماعيل.
﴿كل من الصابرين﴾: كل: mubtadaʾ (subject); من الصابرين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿وأدخلناهم في رحمتنا إنهم من الصالحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أدخلناهم: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في رحمتنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أدخلناهم﴾; إنهم: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); من الصالحين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إنهم من الصالحين﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿وذا النون إذ ذهب مغاضبا فظن أن لن نقدر عليه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ذا النون: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "remember"; it involves the omission of a muḍāf, the implied form being: "and remember the story of Dhū al-Nūn when he went off… etc."; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; إذ: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted muḍāf; the clause ﴿ذهب﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); مغاضبًا: ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "angry with his people, not with his Lord". فظن: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ظن is conjoined to ذهب; the fāʿil (agent) of ظن is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو; أن is lightened from the heavy (anna), its noun (ism) being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause ﴿لن نقدر عليه﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿أن لن نقدر عليه﴾ fills the place of the two objects of ظن.
﴿فنادى في الظلمات أن لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين﴾: فنادى is conjoined to ظن; في الظلمات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿أن﴾ is lightened from the heavy, its noun being the pronoun of the matter, and the clause ﴿لا إله إلا أنت﴾ is the khabar. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because calling out carries the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. سبحانك: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إني: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; the clause ﴿كنت من الظالمين﴾ is the khabar of إن; ﴿من الظالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كنت; the clause ﴿إني كنت ...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿فاستجبنا له ونجيناه من الغم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause ﴿استجبنا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نادى﴾; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استجبنا﴾; نجيناه: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من الغم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نجيناه﴾.
﴿وكذلك ننجي المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كذلك: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "with a rescue like that do We rescue the believers"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ننجي المؤمنين: imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿وزكريا إذ نادى ربه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; زكريا: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "remember"; it involves the omission of a muḍāf, the implied form being: "and remember the story of Zechariah when he called"; إذ: an adverb of past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted muḍāf; the clause ﴿نادى ربه﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿رب لا تذرني فردا وأنت خير الوارثين﴾: رب: one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; لا is of request (ṭalabiyya); تذرني: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت; the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فردًا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وأنت﴾: the wāw conjoins to something omitted, i.e.: "so grant me an heir"; أنت: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿خير الوارثين﴾: khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿فاستجبنا له ووهبنا له يحيى وأصلحنا له زوجه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; استجبنا: verb and fāʿil (agent), the object being omitted, i.e.: "his call"; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استجبنا﴾; ﴿وهبنا﴾: verb and fāʿil; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وهبنا﴾; ﴿يحيى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أصلحنا: verb and fāʿil; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أصلحنا﴾; زوجه: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إنهم كانوا يسارعون في الخيرات﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); إنهم: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); كانوا: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause ﴿يسارعون في الخيرات﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the khabar of إن.
﴿ويدعوننا رغبا ورهبا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يدعوننا is conjoined to يسارعون; يدعوننا: verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; رغبًا ورهبًا: two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), or as an absolute object (maṣdariyya) that matches its governing verb in meaning but not in wording, or as an object of purpose (mafʿūl lahu).
﴿وكانوا لنا خاشعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كانوا: كان is an incomplete past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; خاشعين: its khabar; ﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خاشعين.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿والتي أحصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيها من روحنا وجعلناها وابنها آية للعالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; التي: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: "remember"; the clause ﴿أحصنت فرجها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position; فنفخنا: conjoined to أحصنت; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نفخنا﴾; من روحنا: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿نفخنا﴾. Or ﴿التي﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: "and among what is recited to you is she who guarded…"; جعلناها: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi; ابنها: conjoined to the object of جعلناها, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); آية: second mafʿūl bihi; للعالمين: a naʿt (adjective) of آية.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿إن هذه أمتكم أمة واحدة﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); هذه: the noun (ism) of إن; أمتكم: the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿أمةً﴾: a necessary (lāzima) ḥāl (circumstantial), and it was said: a badal (substitute) from هذه; واحدة: a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وأنا ربكم فاعبدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنا: mubtadaʾ (subject); ربكم: khabar. فاعبدون: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ, implying an omitted condition); اعبدون: imperative verb and fāʿil (agent), and the yāʾ of the speaker, omitted for the script of the Muṣḥaf, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿وتقطعوا أمرهم بينهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تقطعوا: past verb and its fāʿil (agent); أمرهم: accusative (manṣūb) by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "in their affair"; or ﴿تقطعوا﴾ means "they cut up", and ﴿أمرهم﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بينهم﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقطعوا﴾.
﴿كل إلينا راجعون﴾: كل: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إلينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿راجعون﴾; راجعون: khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿فمن يعمل من الصالحات وهو مؤمن فلا كفران لسعيه﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾: a conditional noun causing the jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يعمل: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); من الصالحات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "a righteous deed"; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ; مؤمن: khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); لا is the lā of generic negation; كفران: its noun (ism); ﴿لسعيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar.
﴿وإنا له كاتبون﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; كاتبون: its khabar; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كاتبون﴾; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿وحرام على قرية أهلكناها أنهم لا يرجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, conjoining clauses, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; حرام: a fronted khabar (predicate); على قرية: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرام﴾; the clause ﴿أهلكناها﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قرية﴾; أنهم: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿لا يرجعون﴾ is the khabar of أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أنهم لا يرجعون﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿حتى إذا فتحت يأجوج ومأجوج﴾: حتى is a particle of beginning (ibtidāʾ); إذا: an adverb for future time; the answer to which إذا is attached is omitted, its implied form being: "they said: Woe to us"; or the answer of إذا is ﴿فإذا هي شاخصة ...﴾; فتحت: a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); يأجوج ومأجوج: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and a muḍāf must be implied, namely "their barrier".
﴿وهم من كل حدب ينسلون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāl); ﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is the clause ينسلون; من كل حدب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينسلون﴾.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿واقترب الوعد الحق فإذا هي شاخصة أبصار الذين كفروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿اقترب الوعد﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); الحق: a naʿt (adjective) of الوعد; the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); ﴿هي﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); شاخصة: khabar (predicate); أبصار: the fāʿil of شاخصة; ﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position.
﴿يا ويلنا قد كنا في غفلة من هذا بل كنا ظالمين﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿ويلنا﴾: one addressed (munādā), in a genitive construct (muḍāf), accusative, and the pronoun is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قد﴾: a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿كنا﴾: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); ﴿في غفلة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar; من هذا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غفلة; ﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb); كنا: كان is an incomplete past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ظالمين: its khabar.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t: ﴿إنكم وما تعبدون من دون الله حصب جهنم أنتم لها واردون﴾: إنكم: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿كم﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); ما: conjoined to the kāf; the clause ﴿تعبدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿من دون الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); حصب جهنم: the khabar (predicate) of إنكم; the clause ﴿أنتم لها واردون﴾ is a nominal clause of mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿حصب جهنم﴾.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿لو كان هؤلاء آلهة ما وردوها﴾: لو is conditional, of impossibility (imtināʿiyya); كان: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; هؤلاء: its noun (ism); آلهة: the khabar (predicate) of كان; the clause ﴿ما وردوها﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of لو.
﴿وكل فيها خالدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāl); كل: mubtadaʾ (subject); فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدون﴾; خالدون: khabar.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t: ﴿لهم فيها زفير وهم فيها لا يسمعون﴾: لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); فيها: ḥāl (circumstantial); زفير: the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسمعون﴾; the clause ﴿لا يسمعون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t: ﴿إن الذين سبقت لهم منا الحسنى أولئك عنها مبعدون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين: its noun (ism); the clause ﴿سبقت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبقت﴾; منا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الحسنى: fāʿil (agent); أولئك: mubtadaʾ (subject); عنها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مبعدون; مبعدون: the khabar (predicate) of أولئك; the clause ﴿أولئك عنها مبعدون﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿لا يسمعون حسيسها﴾: لا is negating; يسمعون: imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); حسيسها: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لايسمعون حسيسها﴾ is a badal (substitute) from مبعدون, or a second khabar (predicate) of أولئك, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of مبعدون.
﴿وهم في ما اشتهت أنفسهم خالدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāl) or resumptive; ﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); في ما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدون; the clause ﴿اشتهت أنفسهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; خالدون: the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t: ﴿لا يحزنهم الفزع الأكبر وتتلقاهم الملائكة هذا يومكم الذي كنتم توعدون﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or a badal (substitute) from the preceding clause; لا is negating; يحزنهم: verb and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الفزع: fāʿil (agent); الأكبر: a naʿt (adjective) of الفزع; ﴿تتلقاهم الملائكة﴾: verb, mafʿūl bihi and fāʿil; the clause ﴿هذا يومكم ...﴾ is the speech (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying standing in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "saying: This is your day". هذا: mubtadaʾ (subject); يومكم: khabar (predicate); الذي: a naʿt of ﴿يومكم﴾; كنتم: كان is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) [Translator's note: كان is a verb (one of kāna and its sisters); the source calls it a ḥarf here], and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿توعدون﴾ is the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿يوم نطوي السماء كطي السجل للكتب﴾: يوم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لا يحزنهم﴾; the clause ﴿نطوي﴾ is in the position of genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿نطوي﴾ is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: نحن; السماء: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). كطي: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "like a man's rolling up of his scroll"; ﴿طي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); للكتب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to طي.
﴿كما بدأنا أول خلق نعيده وعدا علينا إنا كنا فاعلين﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun); ﴿بدأنا﴾: verb and fāʿil; ﴿أول خلق﴾: the object of ﴿بدأنا﴾; ﴿وعدًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being: "We promised"; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما بدأنا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وعدًا﴾; إنا: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); كنا: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; فاعلين: its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿كنا فاعلين﴾ is the khabar of إن; the clause ﴿إنا كنا فاعلين﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:105-105.t: ﴿ولقد كتبنا في الزبور من بعد الذكر أن الأرض يرثها عبادي الصالحون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); كتبنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); في الزبور: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كتبنا﴾; ﴿من بعد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الزبور; الذكر: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أن الأرض﴾: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and الأرض is the noun (ism) of أن; the clause ﴿يرثها﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; عبادي: the fāʿil of يرثها; الصالحون: a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿أن الأرض ...﴾ is the object of كتبنا, in the position of accusative.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t: ﴿إن في هذا لبلاغا لقوم عابدين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في هذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); بلاغا: the noun (ism) of إن; لقوم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بلاغًا; عابدين: a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t: ﴿وما أرسلناك إلا رحمة للعالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; أرسلناك: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); رحمة: mafʿūl min ajlihi (object of purpose), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) for intensiveness, in that he is made mercy itself, or with a muḍāf omitted, i.e.: "possessing mercy". للعالمين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رحمة, or attached to رحمة.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿قل إنما يوحى إلي أنما إلهكم إله واحد﴾: إنما is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) particle; يوحى: an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); ﴿إليَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يوحى﴾; أنما: restraining and restrained; إلهكم: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إله﴾: khabar (predicate); واحد: a naʿt (adjective); ﴿أنما إلهكم إله واحد﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يوحى, in the position of nominative.
﴿فهل أنتم مسلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ); هل is an interrogative particle; أنتم: mubtadaʾ; مسلمون: khabar.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿فإن تولوا فقل آذنتكم على سواء﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تولوا: past verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قل: imperative verb; the clause of saying is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; آذنتكم: verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿آذنتكم﴾ is in the position of accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying; على سواء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent and the object in آذنتكم.
﴿وإن أدري أقريب أم بعيد ما توعدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāl); إن is negating; أدري: imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنا; the hamza is for interrogation; قريب: a fronted khabar (predicate); أم: a conjunction; بعيد: conjoined to قريب; ما: the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿توعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. Or قريب is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿ما توعدون﴾ is the fāʿil of قريب, filling the place of its khabar, or the fāʿil of ﴿بعيد﴾ because it is nearer to it, so that the case is one of tanāzuʿ (two governors contending for one word); the clause ﴿أقريب أم بعيد ما توعدون﴾ is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the speech of the saying.

muyesser-irab:110-110.t: ﴿إنه يعلم الجهر من القول ويعلم ما تكتمون﴾: إنه: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يعلم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the fāʿil (agent) of يعلم is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾, referring to Allah the Exalted; الجهر: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من القول﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الجهر; يعلم: conjoined to the first يعلم; ما: mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تكتمون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t: ﴿وإن أدري لعله فتنة لكم ومتاع إلى حين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is negating; أدري: imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنا; لعله: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); فتنة: its khabar (predicate); ﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فتنة; متاع: conjoined to فتنة; إلى حين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of متاع, or attached to متاع; the clause ﴿لعله فتنة ...﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of أدري. And it was said: His saying ﴿ومتاع﴾ does not fall within the scope of the hoping, because it is certain, so it cannot validly be conjoined to فتنة; on this view ﴿متاع﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "and this is an enjoyment for a time", i.e.: "and the postponement of your punishment is an enjoyment for you", and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿قال رب احكم بالحق﴾: رب: one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; احكم: a verb of supplication (duʿāʾ), its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being أنت; بالحق: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to ﴿احكم﴾.
﴿وربنا الرحمن المستعان على ما تصفون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿ربنا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the pronoun ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿الرحمن﴾: khabar (predicate); ﴿المستعان﴾: a second khabar; or الرحمن is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ربنا﴾ and المستعان is the khabar; ﴿على ما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿المستعان﴾; the clause ﴿تصفون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿اقترب للناس حسابهم﴾: (اقترب) is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (للناس) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اقترب﴾; and (حسابهم) is the fāʿil (agent) of (اقترب).
﴿وهم في غفلة معرضون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (في غفلة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted first khabar (predicate); (معرضون) is a second khabar; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الناس).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿ما يأتيهم من ذكر من ربهم محدث إلا استمعوه وهم يلعبون﴾: the clause gives the reason for the preceding clause, so it has no grammatical position; (ما) is negating; (يأتيهم) is an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من) is connective (ṣila), because it is preceded by negation; (ذكر) is a noun genitive (majrūr) in form and nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the fāʿil (agent); (من ربهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of ﴿ذكر﴾, or attached to ﴿يأتيهم﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿ذكر﴾, because it is described by ﴿محدث﴾; (محدث) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ذكر﴾; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the exception is emptied (mufarragh); the clause ﴿استمعوه﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in (يأتيهم). (وهم): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يلعبون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿وهم يلعبون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of (استمعوه).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿لاهية قلوبهم﴾: (لاهية) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of (يلعبون) or from the fāʿil of (استمعوه); and (قلوبهم) is the fāʿil of (لاهية).
﴿وأسروا النجوى الذين ظلموا هل هذا إلا بشر مثلكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (أسروا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (النجوى) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وأسروا النجوى﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (الذين) is a badal (substitute) from the plural wāw in ﴿وأسروا﴾; the clause ﴿ظلموا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position; (هل) is a particle of interrogation; (هذا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (بشر) is the khabar (predicate); and (مثلكم) is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿أفتأتون السحر وأنتم تبصرون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ conjoins to something implied; (تأتون السحر) is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is circumstantial; (أنتم) is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿تبصرون﴾ is the khabar; the clause ﴿وأنتم تبصرون﴾ is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of (تأتون); and the two interrogative clauses ﴿هل هذا إلا بشر مثلكم﴾ and ﴿أفتاتون السحر﴾ are in the position of the accusative as a badal from (النجوى), because they serve as its explanation; or in the position of the accusative as the content of an omitted verb of saying (maqūl qawl); or in the position of the accusative as reporting (maḥkiyyatān) the secret talk (النجوى), because it has the meaning of speech.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿قال ربي يعلم القول في السماء والأرض وهو السميع العليم﴾: (ربي) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يعلم القول﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (في السماء والأرض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (القول), or attached to ﴿يعلم﴾; ﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; (السميع) and (العليم) are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾; and the clause ﴿ربي يعلم القول﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿بل قالوا أضغاث أحلام﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (قالوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (أضغاث أحلام) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the content of (قالوا) (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بل افتراه﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression; (افتراه) is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بل هو شاعر﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression; ﴿هو شاعر﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and its khabar.
﴿فليأتنا بآية كما أرسل الأولون﴾: (فليأتنا): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it discloses an implied condition, as though they had said: "and if it is not as we said, then let him bring us a sign"; the lām is the lām of command; ﴿يأت﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi; and (بآية) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتنا﴾. (كما): the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of (آية), the implied sense being: "let him bring us a sign that is like the sign with which the former ones were sent", ﴿ما﴾ then being a relative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); or the kāf is in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied sense being: "let him bring us a sign with a bringing like the sending of the former ones", ﴿ما﴾ then being maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); (أرسل) is a past [verb] in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); (الأولون) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ and the verb after it is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿ما آمنت قبلهم من قرية أهلكناها أفهم يؤمنون﴾: (ما) is negating; (آمنت) is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (قبلهم) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنت﴾; (من) is a connective (ṣila) preposition; (قرية) is a noun genitive (majrūr) in form and nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the fāʿil (agent), and it is the fāʿil of (آمنت); (أهلكناها) is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أهلكناها﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of (قرية). (أفهم): the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يؤمنون﴾ is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا قبلك إلا رجالا نوحي إليهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (أرسلنا) is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (قبلك) is an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (رجالا) is the object of (أرسلنا); the clause ﴿نوحي إليهم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رجالا﴾; and the imperfect form is used to recount a past state (ḥikāyat al-ḥāl al-māḍiya).
﴿فاسألوا أهل الذكر إن كنتم لا تعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (اسألوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; (أهل الذكر) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ being its noun (ism) and the clause ﴿لا تعلمون﴾ its khabar (predicate); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by ﴿فاسألوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وما جعلناهم جسدا لا يأكلون الطعام﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (جعلناهم) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (جسدًا) is the second object if (جعل) has the meaning of "turning into" (al-taṣyīr), and if it has the meaning of "creating", then (جسدًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) interpreted as a derived word; (لا) is negating; (يأكلون) is a verb and its fāʿil; (الطعام) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿لا يأكلون الطعام﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿جسدًا﴾; it is also said: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun ﴿هم﴾ in ﴿جعلناهم﴾.
﴿وما كانوا خالدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (كان) is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the plural wāw is its noun (ism), and (خالدين) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿وما جعلناهم﴾.

nahhas-irab:40-40.t: (هُمْ) is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); and [the lā] operates only on a definite noun. (يُنْظَرُونَ) is in the position of the khabar (predicate).

nahhas-irab:42-45.t:
(قُلْ مَنْ يَكْلَؤُكُمْ): if you lighten the hamza, you make it intermediate between hamza and wāw, and that is why it is written with a wāw. Al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ reported two further ways of lightening it: «قل من يكلوكم» with fatḥa on the lām and the wāw unvowelled, and they [both] reported «من يكلاكم». He said: As for «يكلاكم», it is wrong on two counts. The first is that replacing the hamza [with a letter] is permitted only in poetry. The other is that the two of them say in the past tense «كليته», so the meaning is overturned, because «كليته» means "I hurt his kidney (kulya)"; and whoever says to a man «كلأك الله» has [in that form] prayed against him, that Allah afflict him with pain in his kidney. The proof of this is that one does not say «رجل مكليّ» except from this [meaning]. This is what is heard [from the Arabs], and we pay no attention to a report of usage that is not sound. As for (يَكْلَؤُكُمْ), Sībawayh reported something like it at the end of a word: that some of the Arabs say «هو الوثو», replacing the hamza with a wāw out of eagerness to make it clear, and in the genitive «من الوثي»; and «هو الكلو», «من الكلي», and «أخذت الكلا».
Al-Farrāʾ said: Whoever says «يكلوهم» says in the past tense «كلات», dropping the hamza (al-nabra).
Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī read «ولا تسمع الصم الدعاء», making the two of them [الصم and الدعاء] objects; some of the philologists objected to him, saying: according to his reading it ought to have been «إذا ما تنذرهم». Abū Jaʿfar said: That is permissible, because the meaning is already known.

nahhas-irab:47-47.t: (مِثْقالَ حَبَّةٍ) is the ism of kāna, and it has no khabar, because it [kāna] means "occurred". The accusative is also permissible, on the basis that you imply its ism within it.

nahhas-irab:48-48.t:
It is related from Ibn ʿAbbās and ʿIkrima: «ولقد آتينا موسى وهارون الفرقان ضياء» without the wāw. Al-Farrāʾ claimed that omitting the wāw and including it are the same, as He, Majestic and Mighty, said: (وَحِفْظاً) [al-Ṣāffāt: 6 and 7]. Abū Isḥāq rejected this view of his, because the wāw comes for a meaning and so is not made redundant. He said: The interpretation of al-Furqān is the Torah, because in it is the distinction (farq) between the lawful and the unlawful. He said:
«وضياء» is like (فِيهِ هُدىً وَنُورٌ) [al-Māʾida: 46]. Al-Farrāʾ allowed [the accusative] in (وَهذا ذِكْرٌ مُبارَكٌ أَنْزَلْناهُ), with the meaning "We sent it down blessed".

nahhas-irab:51-51.t: (وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنا إِبْراهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ): two objects. Al-Farrāʾ said: «رشده» means his guidance.

nahhas-irab:52-52.t: (إِذْ قالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ): Abū Isḥāq said: «إذ» is in the position of accusative (manṣūb), that is: We gave him his right guidance at that time.

nahhas-irab:58-58.t: (وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ) [Translator's note: the source text has this heading here, which belongs to verse 85; the comment that follows concerns (فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذاذاً) in verse 58.] It came in the masculine because they treated the idols as beings endowed with reason in their worship of them. (إِلَّا كَبِيراً لَهُمْ) is [accusative] by exception.

nahhas-irab:60-60.t:
Abū Isḥāq said: «إبراهيم» is nominative on two grounds: in the sense "he is Ibrāhīm" and "the one known by it is Ibrāhīm", and as a vocative. Abū Jaʿfar said: The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [of «يقال»], according to the school of al-Khalīl, may Allah have mercy on him, and Sībawayh, is «له», just as you say «سير به» [Translator's note: the printed text reads «سيريه»]. According to the school of Muḥammad ibn Yazīd [al-Mubarrad], the nāʾib fāʿil is implied, that is, "the saying is said to him", and the implication was needed because «إبراهيم» cannot be the nāʾib fāʿil; indeed that is impossible on every view, because whoever says «قلت زيدا منطلقا», in the anomalous dialect, does not say:
"I spoke to him and said to him Ibrāhīm" except in the nominative; and even though that dialect is anomalous, it is not used in the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, because of its anomaly and its departure from analogy. Had it not been that no scholar we know of has held this view, we would have added to the explanation; but we can dispense with that by what has preceded and what we have described: that whoever makes this nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil is obliged to say «قلت زيدا», just as when he says «يضرب زيد» he says «ضربت زيدا»; yet no one says «قلت زيدا», nor does it have any meaning. He would also be obliged to read (سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلاثَةٌ) [al-Kahf: 5] [Translator's note: the verse is al-Kahf 22] in the accusative. Since he is obliged to say what no one says, there is no need for more. Even if there were nothing in this but that the grammarians teach the learner that what follows «القول» is reported speech (maḥkī), so they say «قلت له زيد خارج», and likewise «قيل له», with no difference between the two verbs in the reporting [that would suffice].

nahhas-irab:67-67.t: (أُفٍّ لَكُمْ وَلِما تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ) (67): Abū Isḥāq said: «أُفٍّ لكم», «وأفَّ», and «وأفُّ لكم»; and it takes tanwīn (nunation) in all three dialects; and one says «أفّه». Whoever puts kasra does so because of the meeting of two unvowelled letters; he said: most sound-words (aṣwāt) are indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra; fatḥa because it is light; ḍamma by assimilation (itbāʿ); and the tanwīn distinguishes the definite from the indefinite.

nahhas-irab:71-71.t:
(وَنَجَّيْناهُ وَلُوطاً) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. (إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بارَكْنا فِيها) [is feminine] because «الأرض» is feminine. As for the poet's words: [al-Mutaqārib] 302-
فلا مزنة ودقت ودقها ... ولا أرض أبقل إبقالها
(No rain-cloud ever poured down its rain like it, nor did any land put forth herbage like its herbage.)
Abū Ḥātim related it as:
«ولا أرض أبقلت إبقالها»
disliking the masculine treatment of «الأرض». Abū Jaʿfar said:
There is nothing objectionable in this, because it is a non-real (ghayr ḥaqīqī) feminine [Translator's note: the printed text reads «تأنيث حقيقي» ("a real feminine"), which contradicts the argument; the sense requires "non-real"]. Muḥammad ibn Yazīd said: if you said «هدم دارك» it would be permissible. The Kufans say: the masculine is permissible because there is no marker of the feminine in it.

nahhas-irab:73-73.t: [«إقام»:] the original is «أقوام»; the vowel of the wāw was thrown onto the qāf, the wāw turned into an alif, and it was dropped because of the meeting of two unvowelled letters. If you use it on its own you add the hāʾ [«إقامة»], and dropping it is ugly because it is a compensation for what was dropped.

nahhas-irab:74-74.t: (وَلُوطاً آتَيْناهُ حُكْماً وَعِلْماً) in the sense: "and remember Lūṭ", or in the sense "and We gave Lūṭ"; [likewise] (وَنُوحاً).

nahhas-irab:78-78.t: (وَداوُدَ وَسُلَيْمانَ) in the sense "and remember". «داود» is a diptote because it is a foreign name in which the article al- would not be fitting; and «سليمان» is a diptote because at its end are an added alif and nūn.

nahhas-irab:79-79.t: (فَفَهَّمْناها سُلَيْمانَ): Abū Isḥāq said: that is, We made him understand the case. (وَسَخَّرْنا مَعَ داوُدَ الْجِبالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَ): [الطير] is conjoined to «الجبال», and it may be in the sense of "with the birds", as you say «التقى الماء والخشبة» (the water and the plank met). Abū Isḥāq said: «الطير» in the nominative is also permissible, in the sense "they glorify, they and the birds". He said (وَكُنَّا فاعِلِينَ) means: We are able to do what We will. Someone else said: the meaning is "We were doing such signs as these for the prophets, Allah's blessings be upon them".

nahhas-irab:81-81.t:
(وَلِسُلَيْمانَ الرِّيحَ عاصِفَةً) is conjoined, that is: "and We subjected the wind to Sulaymān". ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Aʿraj read «ولسليمان الريحُ» in the nominative, cutting it off from what precedes and making it nominative as mubtadaʾ, as you say:
«أعطيت زيدا درهما ولعمر دينار» (I gave Zayd a dirham, and ʿAmr has a dinar).

nahhas-irab:82-82.t: (مِنَ) is in the position of accusative if you make «الريح» accusative, and the nominative as mubtadaʾ is also permissible. If you make «الريح» nominative, then «من» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to it, or, if you wish, as mubtadaʾ as well. (يَغُوصُونَ) follows the meaning of «من»; were it outside the Quran, «يغوص» would be permissible, following the wording.

nahhas-irab:84-84.t: (فَاسْتَجَبْنا لَهُ وَآتَيْناهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ): the people of tafsīr (exegesis) have two views on its meaning. From Mujāhid and ʿIkrima, by two sound chains of transmission, they said: It was said to Ayyūb, Allah bless him and give him peace: "We have given you your family in Paradise; if you wish We will leave them for you in the Hereafter, and if you wish We will give them to you in this world." Mujāhid said: So Allah, Majestic and Mighty, left them for him in Paradise and gave him their like in this world. ʿIkrima said: He chose that they be his in Paradise and that he be given their like in this world. Al-Ḍaḥḥāk said: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd said: Ayyūb's family, peace be upon him, had died except for his wife, so Allah, Majestic and Mighty, brought them back to life for him and gave him their like along with them. From Ibn ʿAbbās, Allah's mercy be upon him, he said: His sons had died, so they were brought back to life for him, and their like were born to them along with them.

nahhas-irab:85-85.t: (وَإِسْماعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ) in the sense: "and remember such-and-such".

nahhas-irab:87-87.t:
Abū Jaʿfar said: We have mentioned from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr that he said: «مغاضبا» [means angry] for his Lord, Majestic and Mighty.
Someone who does not know the language may deny this, but it is a correct view, and the meaning is "angry for the sake of his Lord", as you say «غضبت لك», that is, "for your sake". And the believer becomes angry for Allah, Majestic and Mighty, when He is disobeyed. Most philologists hold that the saying of the Prophet ﷺ to ʿĀʾisha, may Allah be pleased with her, «اشترطي لهم الولاء» is of this kind. Al-Ḍaḥḥāk said: (إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغاضِباً), that is, [angry] with his people; so the meaning of this would be that he was angry with them because of their disobedience. Al-Akhfash said: He was only angry with one of the kings. Al-Ḥasan read «فظنّ أن لن يقدر عليه», and Yaʿqūb the reader read «فظنّ أن لن يقدر عليه» ]. [Translator's note: both readings are printed identically and unvowelled, and a stray "]" follows; the vowelling that distinguished them has been lost in the source.]

nahhas-irab:90-90.t: We have mentioned that the meaning of (وَأَصْلَحْنا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ) is that she had been ill-natured; and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr said: she had been unable to bear children. Abū Isḥāq said: (وَيَدْعُونَنا رَغَباً) as a maṣdar (verbal noun); and «ورُغْبا» like «بُخْلا», and «ورَغَبا» like «بَخَلا». [Translator's note: the source is unvowelled here; the vowelling «رُغْبا/رَغَبا» and «بُخْلا/بَخَلا» is supplied from the sense of the comparison.]

nahhas-irab:91-91.t: (وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَها) is in the position of accusative in the sense "and remember". (وَجَعَلْناها وَابْنَها آيَةً لِلْعالَمِينَ): and He did not say "two signs". Abū Isḥāq said: because the sign in the two of them is one, since she bore him without a male. According to the school of Sībawayh, the implied form is: "We made her a sign for the worlds, and We made her son a sign for the worlds", then [one] was omitted. According to the school of Muḥammad ibn Yazīd, the meaning is "We made her a sign for the worlds, and her son", like (وَاللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُرْضُوهُ) [al-Tawba: 62]. In the story of Dhū al-Nūn there is a word that is difficult to parse in the reading of ʿĀṣim: «وكذلك نُجّي المؤمنين» with a single nūn, because it is so in the Muṣḥaf. The grammarians spoke about this: some of them said it is a solecism (laḥn), because it puts the nāʾib fāʿil in the accusative; Abū Isḥāq held this view. Al-Farrāʾ and Abū ʿUbayd held that the meaning is: "and thus the saving (al-najāʾ) is made to save the believers". Abū Isḥāq said: this is wrong; «ضُرِب زيدا», meaning "the beating [was done] to Zayd", is not permissible, because there is no benefit in it, since «ضرب» already indicates beating. Abū ʿUbayd has another view on it, which is that he assimilated the nūn into the jīm. This view is not permitted by any grammarian we know of, because of the distance [in articulation] of the nūn from the jīm, so it is not assimilated into it; and in (مَنْ جاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ) [al-Anʿām: 160] one may not say «مجّاء بالحسنة». Abū Jaʿfar said: I have not heard anything on this better than something I heard from ʿAlī ibn Sulaymān [al-Akhfash the Younger]. He said: the original is «نُنَجّي», and one of the two nūns was dropped because they come together, just as one of the two tāʾs is dropped because they come together, as in the words of Allah, Majestic and Mighty, (وَلا تَفَرَّقُوا) [al-Anʿām: 103] [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse is Āl ʿImrān 103], whose original is «تتفرقوا». The proof that what he said is correct is that ʿĀṣim reads «نجّي» with the yāʾ unvowelled; had it been as those we mentioned interpreted it, it would have had fatḥa.

nahhas-irab:92-92.t: (إِنَّ هذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً واحِدَةً) as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Abū Isḥāq said: that is, "this is your community in the state of its being united"; when it splits apart it does not enter into that. He said: «إنّ هذه أمتكم أمة واحدة» is also permissible [in the nominative], making «أمتكم» a badal (substitute) from «هذه», and there is a sense of tawkīd (emphasis) in it. Abū Jaʿfar said: Ibn Abī Isḥāq read (وَإِنَّ هذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةٌ واحِدَةٌ) [Translator's note: the source prints the reading with the accusative vowelling of the standard text; the parsing that follows shows it is the nominative «أمةٌ واحدةٌ»]: «أمتكم» is the khabar of inna, and «وأمة واحدة» is a khabar after a khabar; or, if you wish, on the implication of a mubtadaʾ; or, if you wish, as a badal of an indefinite from a definite.

nahhas-irab:94-94.t: Al-Kisāʾī said: In the reading (ḥarf) of Ibn Masʿūd: «فلا كفر لسعيه»; and «كفر», «كفران» and «كفور» have one meaning.

nahhas-irab:95-95.t:
(وَحَرامٌ عَلى قَرْيَةٍ) is the reading of Zayd ibn Thābit and the people of Medina; and from ʿAlī, Ibn Masʿūd and Ibn ʿAbbās: «وحِرْم على قرية». It is also related from Ibn ʿAbbās that he read «وحَرِمَ على قرية» with fatḥa on the ḥāʾ and the mīm and kasra on the rāʾ, and it is related from him with ḍamma on the rāʾ and fatḥa on the ḥāʾ and the mīm [«وحَرُمَ»].
The verse is difficult, and we have mentioned several views on it. Among the best and most weighty things said about it is what Ibn ʿUyayna, Ibn ʿUlayya, Hushaym, Ibn Idrīs, Muḥammad ibn Fuḍayl, Sulaymān ibn Ḥayyān and Muʿallā related from Dāwūd ibn Abī Hind, from ʿIkrima, from Ibn ʿAbbās, may Allah have mercy on him, concerning His words, Majestic and Mighty, (وَحَرامٌ عَلى قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْناها): he said: "it is decreed"; (أَنَّهُمْ لا يَرْجِعُونَ): he said: "they will not repent". Abū Jaʿfar said: The derivation of this is clear from the language. Its explanation is that the meaning of «حرم الشيء» is that it was forbidden and prevented, just as the meaning of «أحلّ» is that it was made permissible and not prevented. So if «حرام» and «حرم» have one meaning, its meaning is that departure from it has been made narrow and prevented, and by this it has entered the category of the forbidden. As for Abū ʿUbayd's saying that «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), a group rejected it, because it is not made redundant in a place like this, nor where it would cause ambiguity. And if it were redundant the interpretation would still be far-fetched, because if he meant "it is forbidden for a town that We destroyed that they return to the world", there is no benefit in that; and if he meant repentance, repentance is not forbidden.

nahhas-irab:96-97.t:
(حَتَّى إِذا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ): ʿĀṣim and al-Aʿraj read (يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ) with hamza. Abū Isḥāq said: they are both derived from «أجّة الحريق» (the blaze of fire) and from «ملح أجاج» (bitter salt water). They are diptotes, being made names for the two tribes, on the patterns fāʿūl and mafʿūl; and whoever does not use the hamza makes them foreign words, according to the view of most grammarians. Al-Akhfash said: «يأجوج» is from «يججت», and «مأجوج»
is from «مججت». ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa related from Ibn ʿAbbās (وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ): he said: they will come forward from every height. The implied form in Arabic is: "until, when the barrier of Yaʾjūj and Maʾjūj is opened", like (وَسْئَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ) [Yūsuf: 82]. As for the jawāb (answer) of «إذا», there are three views on it. Al-Kisāʾī and al-Farrāʾ said: "until, when Yaʾjūj and Maʾjūj are opened, the true promise draws near", the wāw being redundant according to them; and al-Farrāʾ recited: [al-Ṭawīl] 303-
فلمّا أجزنا ساحة الحيّ وانتحى ... بنا بطن خبت ذي قفاف عقنقل
(When we had crossed the open ground of the tribe, and there turned aside with us the hollow of a plain with rough ridges and winding sand-dunes.)
The meaning according to him is «انتحى» [without the wāw]. Al-Kisāʾī allowed that the jawāb of «إذا» be (فَإِذا هِيَ شاخِصَةٌ أَبْصارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا). The third view is that the meaning is "they will say: (يا وَيْلَنا)", then «قالوا» was omitted. This is the view of Abū Isḥāq, and it is a good view. Allah, Majestic and Mighty, said: (وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِياءَ ما نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونا إِلَى اللَّهِ) [al-Zumar: 3], the meaning being "they say"; and omission of the verb of saying is frequent.

nahhas-irab:98-98.t: The meaning is: you and the idols that you worship besides Allah. ʿĪsā, Allah bless him and give him peace, does not come under this, nor ʿUzayr, nor the angels, because «ما» is for non-humans. The meaning is: because their idols will enter the Fire with them so that they may be punished by them, either by their being heated and made to stick to them, or by their being rebuked for worshipping them. «ما» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ism of inna, and the khabar is (حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ), that is, it will be pelted with the gravel (ḥaṣbāʾ).

nahhas-irab:99-99.t: (وَكُلٌّ فِيها خالِدُونَ): mubtadaʾ and khabar; and «خالدين» in the accusative is permissible outside the Quran.

nahhas-irab:100-100.t: It has been said: there is an omission in the speech, and the meaning (and Allah knows best) is: "and they, in it, do not hear anything that would please them", because they are deaf.

nahhas-irab:101-101.t:
(إِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِنَّا الْحُسْنى): it has been said: by it is meant Paradise; and it has been said: by it is meant the promise.
(أُولئِكَ عَنْها مُبْعَدُونَ): mubtadaʾ and khabar, in the position of the khabar of inna.

nahhas-irab:102-102.t: (لا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَها): Abū ʿUthmān al-Nahdī said: On the Bridge (al-ṣirāṭ) there are snakes that sting the people of the Fire, and they say: «حسّ حسّ» (ah, ah).

nahhas-irab:103-103.t: (لا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ) is according to the dialect of those who say «حزن يحزن», which is the more eloquent of the two dialects, and the Kufans read with it throughout the Quran. Ibn Muḥayṣin read according to the dialect of those who say «أحزن يحزن» throughout the Quran, and Nāfiʿ read with it except in this word; and Abū Jaʿfar read with it in this word only, and read all its counterparts in the Quran according to the dialect of those who say «حزن يحزن».

nahhas-irab:104-104.t: (كَما بَدَأْنا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ): Sufyān said, from Salama ibn Kuhayl, from Abū al-Zaʿrāʾ, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd, who said: Allah will send water from beneath the Throne like the semen of men, and from it their flesh and their bodies will grow, as the earth grows from moist soil; and he recited (كَما بَدَأْنا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ). Abū Jaʿfar said: In His words, Majestic and Mighty, (وَعْداً عَلَيْنا) there is an omission, and the meaning (and Allah knows best) is "upon Us is its fulfilment and keeping it"; then He emphasised that with His words, Majestic and Mighty, (إِنَّا كُنَّا فاعِلِينَ). Abū Isḥāq said: the meaning of (إِنَّا كُنَّا فاعِلِينَ) is "We are able to do whatever We will".

nahhas-irab:105-105.t: (وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنا فِي الزَّبُورِ): «الزَّبور» and «الكتاب» are one, and therefore it is permissible to call the Torah and the Gospel «زبور», from «زبرت», that is, "I wrote"; its plural is «زُبُر». Whoever says «زُبور» makes it the plural of «زِبْر». (أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُها عِبادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ): the best thing said about it is that the land of Paradise is meant, because the land in this world has been inherited by the righteous and others.

nahhas-irab:106-106.t: Sufyān said: It has reached me that they are the people of the five prayers.

nahhas-irab:107-107.t: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr said, from Ibn ʿAbbās: Muḥammad, peace be upon him, was a mercy to all people: whoever believed in him and affirmed him was blessed, and whoever did not believe in him was kept safe from what befell [earlier] nations of being swallowed by the earth and drowning.

nahhas-irab:108-108.t: «إنّما» with kasra is permissible, because the meaning of «يوحى إليّ» is "it is said to me".

nahhas-irab:109-109.t: (وَإِنْ أَدْرِي) in the sense «ما أدري» (I do not know). «أدري» is in the position of nominative, because it is an imperfect verb on which no particle of the subjunctive or jussive has acted; the ḍamma was dropped from the yāʾ because the ḍamma is heavy on it. (أَقَرِيبٌ أَمْ بَعِيدٌ ما تُوعَدُونَ): it has been said: He means the Resurrection.

nahhas-irab:111-111.t: (وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ): it has been said: He means "I do not know; perhaps the respite is a trial for you", that is, a test and an intensification in worship. (وَمَتاعٌ إِلى حِينٍ): until the term comes to an end.

nahhas-irab:112-112.t:
(قالَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ): [«ربّ»] is in the position of accusative because it is a muḍāf vocative. Whoever reads «ربّي أحكمُ بالحقّ», it is mubtadaʾ and khabar. It is related from Abū Jaʿfar that he read «ربُّ احكم بالحقّ», and this, according to the grammarians, is a solecism: according to them one may not say «رجلُ أقبل» until you say «يا رجل» or something like it.
(وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمنُ الْمُسْتَعانُ عَلى ما تَصِفُونَ), that is, against the disbelief that you describe.

zajjaj:1-1.t:
Sūrat al-Anbiyāʾ (The Prophets)
Meccan
﷽
His words, Mighty and Majestic is He: ﴿اقْتَرَبَ لِلنّاسِ حِسابُهُمْ﴾ — its meaning is: ”اِقْتَرَبَتِ القِيامَةُ“ ("the Resurrection has drawn near"); similar to it is ﴿اقْتَرَبَتِ السّاعَةُ وانْشَقَّ القَمَرُ﴾ [al-Qamar: 1]. And the meaning — and Allah knows best — is: ”اِقْتَرَبَ لِلنّاسِ وقْتَ حِسابِهِمْ“ ("the time of their reckoning has drawn near to the people").

zajjaj:2-2.t: And His words: ﴿ما يَأْتِيهِمْ مِن ذِكْرٍ مِن رَبِّهِمْ مُحْدَثٍ﴾ — the genitive is the reading. Outside the [canonical] reading, ”مُحْدَثًا“ and ”مُحْدَثٌ“ are permissible: the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the nominative by implying ”هُوَ“.

zajjaj:3-3.t:
﴿لاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the sense of ”إلّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وهم يَلْعَبُونَ“; its meaning is: ”اِسْتَمَعُوهُ لاعِبِينَ لاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ“ ("they listened to it playing, their hearts distracted"). It is also possible that ”لاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ“ is accusative [as a ḥāl] through His saying ”يَلْعَبُونَ“.
﴿وَأسَرُّوا النَّجْوى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ — regarding ”أسَرُّوا“ there are two views. The better of them is that ”اَلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا“ is in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) for the wāw of ”أسَرُّوا“, explaining what the wāw refers to. The meaning is: ”إلّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وهم يَلْعَبُونَ وأسَرُّوا النَّجْوى“; then He made clear who these are, so it is a badal for the wāw. It may also be nominative by way of censure (dhamm), in the sense of ”هُمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا“ ("they are those who did wrong"); and it may be in the position of the accusative, in the sense of ”أعْنِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا“ ("I mean those who did wrong"). [Translator's note: the text announces two views but goes on to list three possibilities.]
And His words: ﴿هَلْ هَذا إلا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ﴾ explain what they kept secret; the meaning is: ”قالُوا سِرًّا: هَلْ هَذا إلا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ؟“ ("they said in secret: is this anything but a human being like you?"), meaning the Prophet ﷺ. Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, informed them that He knows what is said in the heaven and the earth, and He acquainted the Prophet ﷺ with what they said and kept secret.

zajjaj:4-4.t: ﴿قالَ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ القَوْلَ في السَّماءِ والأرْضِ﴾ — it has been read ”قَلْ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ القَوْلَ“ and ”قالَ رَبِّي“. [Translator's note: ”قَلْ“ is as printed; the variant intended is presumably the imperative ”قُلْ“.]

zajjaj:5-5.t:
And His words: ﴿بَلْ قالُوا أضْغاثُ أحْلامٍ﴾, i.e. they said: what the Prophet ﷺ brings is jumbled dreams. It has come in the exegesis: terrors of dreams. ”اَلْأضْغاثُ“ in the language are things mixed together.
﴿بَلِ افْتَراهُ بَلْ هو شاعِرٌ﴾, i.e. they began contradicting their statements one with another, saying at one time "these are dreams", at another "this is poetry", and at another "fabricated".
﴿فَلْيَأْتِنا بِآيَةٍ كَما أُرْسِلَ الأوَّلُونَ﴾ — so they proposed the signs after which there is no respite if they are rejected. So Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, said: ﴿ما آمَنَتْ قَبْلَهم مِن قَرْيَةٍ أهْلَكْناها أفَهم يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ [al-Anbiyāʾ: 6], i.e. the people of no town to which these signs came believed, until Allah made their extirpation and destruction by punishment due.
Allah made the appointed time of this community the Resurrection, saying: ﴿بَلِ السّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهم والسّاعَةُ أدْهى وأمَرُّ﴾ [al-Qamar: 46]. And Allah had given them the signs by which they could see clearly the prophethood of the Prophet ﷺ: the Qurʾān, which they were challenged to produce a sūra like; the splitting of the moon; and His saying: ﴿لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ﴾ [al-Tawba: 33] — and the people of Islam prevailed until they became more numerous than any other group, so that the people of no single religion have the numbers of the people of Islam; and Allah also made it prevail through the decisive proof.

zajjaj:7-7.t: And His words, Exalted is He: ﴿وَما أرْسَلْنا قَبْلَكَ إلا رِجالا نُوحِي إلَيْهِمْ فاسْألُوا أهْلَ الذِّكْرِ﴾, i.e. ”سَلُوا كُلَّ مَن يُقِرُّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِن أهْلِ التَّوْراةِ، والإنْجِيلِ“ ("ask everyone among the people of the Torah and the Gospel who acknowledges the Messenger of Allah ﷺ"). ﴿إنْ كُنْتُمْ لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾, i.e. ”إنْ كُنْتُمْ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا أنَّ الرُّسُلَ بَشَرٌ“ ("if you did not know that the messengers are human beings"). This asking — and Allah knows best — is of those among the people of these scriptures who were believers, because acceptance is [of reports] from people of truthfulness and trustworthiness.
